title: Allentown H.S. Student-Athlete Wins 2026 Strength Award Scholarship from Kearny Bank, Presented in Conjunction with NJSIAA
summary: Presented in conjunction with the NJSIAA (New Jersey State Interscholastic Athletic Association), this $2,500 scholarship honors a New Jersey scholastic athlete who perseveres to overcome significant injury or illness and returns to competition.

**About Kearny Bank**


Combining the finest traditions of community banking with the industry’s latest, most effective financial products and services, Kearny Bank provides business and personal clients with the tools for success. Established back in 1884, and now operating from corporate offices in Fairfield, NJ, Kearny Bank’s footprint covers most of New Jersey, along with Brooklyn and Staten Island. Additional information is available at[kearnybank.com](https://www.kearnybank.com/home) or by visiting Kearny Bank’s social media channels:[Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/kearnybank) ,[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/kearny_bank/) ,[X](https://twitter.com/KearnyBank) ,[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/1319584) and[YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCwieXSwL9OscxNRUhzWwQyQ) .
